citations.title: Pack People Development
excerpts: Pack is an AI Change Management Platform that shows companies which skills their people have today, which skills are missing, and what capabilities are needed to achieve their strategic goals. We enable organisations to develop the talent they already have, reduce hiring and training costs, and ensure that every role builds the capabilities required by the business. ... How Pack works? Three integrated steps: Skill mapping: we translate the company’s strategy into a clear skill framework and define the capabilities required for each role. ... Pack unites a rigorous methodology with an AI-native platform to manage the entire talent development lifecycle, from defining strategic skills to developing them at scale.

basis.reasoning: Pack describes mapping current and missing workforce skills, identifying strategic capability needs, and creating AI-powered personalized learning paths for organizations.
